issues: The UI primary flow test fails at step 5 when trying to fill the "Email address" field on the Sign‑Up screen. The <label htmlFor="emailInput"> element points to an input with id="emailInput", but the TextInput component only sets nativeID="emailInput" and does not set an id attribute on web. The same issue exists for the password field (nativeID="passwordInput" without id). Playwright cannot locate the inputs via their labels, causing a timeout. Update expo‑app/src/screens/SignUpScreen.tsx to add the id attribute for web platforms on both the email and password TextInput components (e.g., {...(Platform.OS === 'web' ? { id: 'emailInput' } : {})} and {...(Platform.OS === 'web' ? { id: 'passwordInput' } : {})}). This will allow the label's htmlFor to correctly associate with the input, fixing the UI flow test.
feedback: Add the missing id attributes to the email and password TextInput elements in SignUpScreen (conditionally for web) so that the accessibility labels match the <label> elements. Once this change is made, the UI flow test should be able to locate and fill the fields, and the primary flow validation should pass.
